overview: The committee approved a series of space reductions totaling approximately 20,276 gross square feet and $22 million in estimated savings to increase project efficiency. Members also reviewed sustainability goals, updated the parking program to 477 spaces, and prepared for the MSBA's formal vote to move the project into the schematic design phase.

items.title: Meeting Minutes Approval
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from the July 21 session.

items.title: July 2026 Invoices
items.summary: Approved three invoices for base feasibility and environmental services totaling $134,354.50.

items.title: New Committee Member Introductions
items.summary: Welcomed new voting members Liz Mullane, Tracy Keene, and Jen Belanger, along with non-voting member Kim Clinton.

items.title: Sustainability and Systems Advisory Report
items.summary: The committee reviewed progress on LEED V4 Silver certification, Net Zero goals, and upcoming life cycle cost analyses for HVAC and solar systems. An 'eco-charrette' for community input was announced for September 17.

items.title: Medford Community Media Space Efficiency
items.summary: Approved the elimination of 1,400 square feet of dedicated studio space by adopting a shared-use model with the vocational film and television program. The plan retains dedicated office, playback, and editing space for the station.

items.title: Community Partner Rental Storage
items.summary: Approved the elimination of 910 square feet of storage space formerly offered to long-term renters following a policy change by the School Committee.

items.title: Community Meeting and Language Space
items.summary: Approved the elimination of approximately 3,325 square feet of dedicated multipurpose and language lab rooms by utilizing flexible Large Group Instruction (LGI) spaces.

items.title: Health and Physical Education Reductions
items.summary: Approved a 1,600-square-foot reduction achieved by eliminating a dedicated yoga/CPR room and decreasing the overall locker room footprint.

items.title: Auditorium and Drama Seating Adjustment
items.summary: Approved reducing the auditorium capacity from 1,000 to 750 seats, resulting in a 2,500-square-foot reduction of the 'house' space. The stage size was maintained at 2,500 square feet to accommodate large district-wide musical performances and acoustic equipment.

items.title: Art and Music Space Review
items.summary: Approved reducing the digital art lab by 240 square feet by removing a traditional chemical darkroom in favor of a modern digital curriculum.

items.title: Revised Parking Program
items.summary: Approved a 477-space parking plan that includes 100 student spots and reduced staff and visitor allocations to avoid the necessity of costly tiered parking structures.

items.title: MSBA Feedback and Next Steps
items.summary: The committee reviewed feedback on the Preliminary School Report and noted that the MSBA Board of Directors would vote on August 26 to formally move the project into schematic design.
